reason: I'm not handing my college Microsoft login to some new app just to see notices my portal already shows me. I barely open that account anyway, so I don't feel like I'm missing anything.
objection: Signing in with my college account means I don't know what this app can see about me, and the 'marks and email later' part makes it worse. Why does a deadline feed need that?
would_change_my_mind: If I actually missed an exam notice or deadline because the portal didn't tell me, and the app worked without my college login or clearly showed it only reads notices.
